credits.title: Maserati: The Brothers
credits.overview: Chronicles the Maserati family's journey, from its founding in 1914 to becoming a renowned Italian luxury car manufacturer, alongside rivals Ferrari and Lamborghini.

credits.title: Gospel According to Mary
credits.overview: The story of Mary is reinvented, no longer a spectator but a courageous architect of her own existence.

credits.title: Death of the Ten Commandments
credits.overview: Several European underground directors turn the ancient rules of mankind inside out in this shocking and gore-soaked interpretation of God's laws for man from the Bible. The world is ending, and the 10 commandments are dying.
